StonePharm

Kidney Stone Metabolic Assessment & Pharmacotherapy Support
Clinical decision-support prototype for clinician use. It organizes selected risk factors and prompts consideration of options; it does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace current guidelines or clinical judgment.

Medication options are prompts for clinician review, not patient-specific prescriptions. Confirm stone composition, repeat/validate abnormal urine findings, assess contraindications and interactions, and monitor response after any treatment change.

INFOScope, limitations & clinical references

V1 is a focused educational prototype for adult stone-formers, primarily calcium stone metabolic assessment. It is not validated medical software. It does not calculate doses, predict recurrence, interpret imaging, or replace specialist assessment. Pediatric patients, pregnancy, cystinuria, infection stones, primary hyperoxaluria and complex renal disease require dedicated pathways.

  • European Association of Urology (EAU). Guidelines on Urolithiasis – metabolic evaluation and recurrence prevention. Use the current edition at point of care.
  • American Urological Association (AUA). Medical Management of Kidney Stones guideline. Confirm current recommendations and updates.
  • National Kidney Foundation. Kidney stone prevention and patient education resources.
